Traffic Advisory
Day 9, 3rd October, 2025

Construction of Transit Way (N2) to Connect Central Area with Wuse District with 2 Bridges

In continuation of flag-off and commissioning of projects in the FCT, motorists along Abidjan Street Zone 3 are hereby informed of movement of dignitaries to the venue of the event.

As such, traffic will be slightly staggered during movement especially at the intersection of Sultan Abubakar Way to Abidjan Street.

Traffic and security personnel will be deployed accordingly for seamless movement by 0800hrs.
Your cooperation as usual is highly solicited. 

- Head Traffic, DRTS
